def: A small index below a symbol giving a position: x_3 is the third value. It is a seat number, not multiplication.
The average of the values x_1 to x_n.
Marks an estimate computed from data, as opposed to the true unknown value.
Capital sigma: add up the terms that follow, with the index running from the value below to the value above.
Capital pi: multiply the terms that follow.
The position (or input) at which a quantity is largest, rather than the largest value itself.
The long-run average of a random quantity; in practice estimated by averaging a sample.
The probability of A given that B is known to have happened. The vertical bar reads 'given'.
